# Provenance

This directory contains generated FOI JSON and HTML outputs. MAM-parsed-plus FOI inventories deliberately inspect every parameter of every recognized template, including documentation, apparatus, and alternative branches; question-specific handlers label or exclude those fields.
This file was generated by MAM-basics/py/foi/foi_finals.py.
Payload files in this directory remain in their native data format, so provenance is recorded here rather than inside each file.
